holderQuote: Belavierr was trying to stop Xrn; both she and Grimalkin could see the Antinium gathering magic.
effectQuote: The spell shot towards Xrn’s chest.

holderQuote: Pawn looked at the two Workers. They flanked Belavierr. She spun around, lashed out with her staff.
effectQuote: Mrsha saw the spell shoot at Pawn and screamed. The [Priest]’s mandibles opened. The deathly spell struck the air around him and—vanished.
